notes: Football League clubs. Sourced: friendlies were played from early September (Liverpool Mercury, 3 Sep 1888, docs/data/history/RECRUITMENT_1888-1900.md 2.1) and filled the Saturdays the 22 League fixtures left free. Estimates (D30 A3): the chance per free Saturday (and holiday Monday) that the secretary writes, the 14- and 7-day notice, and the visitors' guarantee of 60s or half the gate, whichever is larger. Guarantee in shillings.
Clubs outside the Football League: friendlies were nearly all their calendar besides the cup ties. Every figure is an estimate (D30 A3): a smaller guarantee (20s) than a League club commands.
Old boys' clubs of amateurs only (the amateur band of contracts.json): fewer fixtures, Saturdays only, their travelling expenses as the guarantee. Every figure is an estimate (D30 A3).
